name: Proxmox LocalAI GPU Node
tagline: LocalAI LXC for Proxmox VE with automatic NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPU passthrough — LLMs, image generation, TTS/STT on OpenAI-compatible APIs
description: One-command Proxmox VE LXC installer for LocalAI with hardware GPU acceleration. Detects NVIDIA, AMD (ROCm), and Intel GPUs, installs matching userspace runtimes, and deploys LocalAI as a systemd service with an OpenAI-compatible API (/v1). Supports LLM chat, image generation (diffusers / stable-diffusion), embeddings, TTS and STT endpoints. Model configs live in a bind-mounted /opt/localai/models directory for easy editing.
features: Auto-detects NVIDIA / AMD / Intel GPUs and installs matching runtimes
Model configs in /opt/localai/models — drop-in YAML, no restart to edit
Image generation via diffusers and stablediffusion-ggml backends
Update script pulls latest LocalAI release from GitHub
Optional model pre-download on install (small LLM + SD1.5)
Hardware-accel where the card supports it (CUDA / ROCm / Level Zero)
notes: NVIDIA cards: host driver required, container gets userspace CUDA via nvidia-container-toolkit. AMD: ROCm userspace. Intel: Level Zero. CPU-only fallback works without any GPU.
